text:
Maria: Quick heads-up planning a small micro-influence + webinar push next week to test an activation path that ties free credits -> prompt templates -> onboarding nudges. Goal: +10% DAU from seeded cohorts; move people from signup -> first 3 queries within 48h. Thoughts?

Ajay: Love it. Which cohort size and which micro-influencers?

Maria: Target 500 seeded signups (A/B split). We'll engage ~10 micro-influencers focused on developer audiences (X + Discord). Each influencer gets 100 starter credits + a 1:1 onboarding slot.

Sasha: Draft social copy and webinar hook ready. Plan to surface two prompt packs: "hackathon-starter" and "sales-cold-email". Example short post: `Tried @RedwoodInference 100 free starter credits + template pack. Join our 30-min workshop tomorrow.`

Kevin: Quick numbers: baseline signup->3queries for past promos ~18%. With credits + templates I model lift to ~26%. For 500 signups that's ~130 extra active users in 48h. Rough CI but directionally useful.

Ellie: Routing note: seeded signups should bypass the generic tour and hit the micro-influencer onboarding flow (prompt-templates modal + CTA "Run sample"). Also enqueue a 24h activation nudge (email + in-app).

Maria: A/B plan: A = 100 credits + templates + webinar invite; B = 100 credits + templates + no webinar (just nudge). Isolates webinar effect.

Sasha: Webinar invite copy (short): "Build with Redwood: 30-min hands-on prompt workshop + free credits." Social CTA: "Sign up, claim credits, bring a prompt we'll optimize it live."

Ajay: Growth ops ask: can we add UTM per influencer and a hidden cohort flag so product detects seeded users?

Kevin: Yes. Use `?utm_source=influencerX` and set signup metadata `seed_cohort: microX`. I'll wire analytics to report funnel by cohort.

Ellie: Onboarding nudge cadence proposal: 0h in-app welcome + templates modal, 24h email with 3 sample prompts, 48h in-app push if no activity. Also offer 1:1 office hours slot for cohort A.

Maria: Budget question: credits cost?

Kevin: Credits = 500 * 100 = 50k starter credits. Expected token use per new user ~200 tokens/day for first two days. Cost estimate: low hundreds USD for the test.

Sasha: Prompt template examples (will push to marketing repo):
```
// hackathon-starter pack
1) "Build a prototype that extracts meeting notes from audio. Show me a prompt chain."
2) "Given this user story, generate a minimal working prompt and test cases."

// sales-cold-email
1) "Rewrite this cold email for VP of Sales, reduce to 4 lines, add specific pain point."
```

Ajay: Timeline? When do influencer posts + webinar go live?

Maria: Influencer posts Tue 10:00 PT, webinar Wed 16:00 PT. Routing + credits live Tue 09:00 PT. Need assets + landing + gated signup by Mon EOD.

Ellie: Gating note: show credits claim after email verification to reduce spam. Flow: email -> verify -> claim credits (auto-add). Product will set `onboarding_variant: A|B`.

Kevin: I'll create cohort dashboards: activation funnel, avg queries/day, 7d retention. Share a Looker link once live.

Sasha: I'll drop social copy + hero image to drive by EOD and post the link here.

Maria: Action items: Sasha (social + templates), Kevin (analytics + cost), Ellie (routing + gating), Ajay (influencer coord), deploy-bot (schedule webinar). Check-in tomorrow 10:00 PT. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Created calendar event "Micro-influencer activation workshop" Wed 16:00 PT invite sent to #marketing.

Ajay: Recommend a small leaderboard / tweet highlight for influencers to encourage follow-ups.

Sasha: Good call will add a referral card they can share.

Maria: One more Q: experiment with credit amounts? Maybe A1 = 100 credits vs A2 = 200 credits (split within cohort)?

Kevin: Statistically underpowered at n=150 each, but directionality possible. Suggest keep main A=100 and run a smaller 200-credit test (n=75) to get a signal.

Ellie: Ops: rollback plan if spam spike, pause credit issuance and require manual whitelist for influencer traffic.

Maria: Great. Update the checklist in the launch doc and I'll finalize the influencer list.

Sasha: Checklist link: https://drive.google.com/marketing/micro-influence-launch (mock link).

Kevin: Analytics placeholder: https://app.redwood/analytics/micro-seed (mock link).

Maria: Thanks all see you tomorrow 10:00 PT. :v:
